title: Places
subtitle: Significant MJ Places
winMessage: You know your way around M & J's world!

groups.name: MJ Schools
groups.details: J attended St. John's and St. Thomas; M attended St. Ben's and the U of MN.

groups.name: Places Where J Lived
groups.details: J grew up in LA, worked for the Jesuit Volunteer Corps in Detroit, was a law clerk in Virginia, MN, and lived in the Whittier neighborhood of Minneapolis.

groups.name: Places Where M Lived
groups.details: M was born in Hastings, MN, grew up in Collegeville Township, taught in Tokyo, Japan, and lives in Uptown Minneapolis.

groups.name: Memorable MJ Trip Destinations
groups.details: Visited Portland, ME; Thunder Bay, Ontario; Monterey, CA; and Boston, MA.
